$Comment: The notice a player gets each time the trick-or-treat line pays out: a toast and a small
pickup sound, to that player alone. The loot table Hallows_Eve_Trick_Or_Treat names this
moment with its Cue, and a cue fires only when the sweets beside it were actually paid.
Reword the toast with the key notify.hallows_eve_treat; add a Broadcast group to tell the
whole server, or delete the Sound group for a silent toast.
